brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
The Pentagon is taking fresh aim at Canada's military readiness and defence spending priorities. [3]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market on whether the Bank of Canada will make no change to the target for the overnight rate at the December interest rate announcement is priced Yes at 49% as of Nov 24, 2026, closing Dec 9, 2026. [E4]
A Polymarket market on a US-Canada diplomatic agreement to lower tariffs by December 31 is priced Yes at 30% as of Nov 24, 2026, closing Jan 1, 2027. [E5]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether the woman who took Canada to court over genocide will obtain a ruling or settlement. [1]
Whether the US sanctions on the Italian mafia group in Canada and the Australian biker gang will lead to enforcement actions in Canada. [2]
